div.div: All In Capital Triage System: Components Map
Part 1 of 2. Screening run, once per application. Rows are actors. Columns are stages. Red boxes are human gates.
Public form or a warm intro. Riya opens the week's batch.
Approve, reject or correct with a one-line reason.
Sees every outcome. Nobody is auto-rejected or auto-advanced.
Deck PDF plus form response. A missing deck is allowed and named as a gap.
Thesis Card, versioned. Only the relevant memo passages. Past corrections for similar companies. The full portfolio list.
Parse. Swap names, emails and phones for a founder ID. Dedupe and queue. Cheap checks first: stage, excluded category, portfolio clash. Flag only. Code checks whether each field is filled.
Each criterion as yes, no or unknown, with source and exact quote. Gaps named. GO, PASS or NEEDS HUMAN with reasons. Status: scored, queued or needs attention.
Company site, search results, news. Cleaned and capped near 2,000 tokens. No logged-in scraping.
Fetch only the named source for an unknown field. On failure: unknown plus reason, then move on.
Judge each criterion against the Thesis Card
Routes every model call. Automatic retries.
Trace per application with prompt version. Cost per call. Daily cap pauses and alerts.

foreignObject.div: Loop B. If a field is unknown. Max 2 per question, 8 per app.
Loop C. Correction and reason stored, then recalled for similar companies.

div.div: Part 2 of 2. Outreach and scheduling run
Starts only after Kushal signs off. The agent keeps a state record per founder and hands off at every limit.
GO applicants get a call invite. PASS applicants get a kind note saying what would change our view.
After the call: one tap. Was it worth 30 minutes? Logged for learning.
Riya takes unclear replies and any loop that hits its limit
Draft the GO invite or the PASS note, using the style notes
Read the reply: interested, not interested, unclear or none
Email status, reply type, follow-ups sent, slots offered and refused, round, meeting status. Style notes from past edits.
Follow up on day 3 and day 7, then stop. Tuesday or Thursday afternoon, 30 minutes. Add Aditya for deeptech. Retry table for every tool.
Free or busy for Riya, and Aditya when needed.
Email goes from Gmail. Invite lands on both calendars.

foreignObject.div: Book only after the founder confirms a slot.
Unclear reply, or a limit is hit. Hand to Riya.

Loop E. No reply: follow up, max 2.
Loop F. New time asked: recheck, max 2 rounds.
Loop D. Riya's edits become style notes for future drafts.
The seven loops. Each one has a limit and a hand-off to a person.

div.div: Run the rubric on past memos. Explain every disagreement. Kushal approves the next version.
Unknown field, so fetch the named source. Max 2 per question, about 8 per application.
Fact fixes stay with one company. Rule fixes need Kushal before they change the rubric.
Draft vs sent becomes versioned style notes. Riya can roll back.
Day 3, day 7, then stop. Mark no response and tell Riya.
Counter-proposal, so recheck. Never repeat a refused slot. Max 2 rounds.
Was the call worth 30 minutes? Read weekly. Feeds loops A and C.

foreignObject.div: Hand-off to a person or record
Human gate. Placed before anything that cannot be undone.
